meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把关分析检测方法是否经得起验证审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要给实验室检测方法准备验证和证明材料。
copy.tagline_en: Prove your lab method is reliable for its intended use before release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must show an analytical method is fit for its intended purpose under regulations.

howto.what: 它会帮你按所选法规框架(ICH Q2(R2)、USP、ICH M10 等)规划分析方法验证、计算线性、精密度、检出限、方法比对等统计量,并生成方案与文档骨架。所有脚本只报告结果,不替你判定方法是否合格。
howto.when: 当你提到「method validation」「AMV」等关键词,或在设计验证方案、评估验证数据、转移方法、判断某个检测方法是否适合其用途时接管。

say.text: 帮我按 ICH Q2(R2) 规划一个 HPLC 含量测定的验证方案
say.note: 生成方案骨架,验收标准留空由你定

say.text: 用 check_response.py 检查这份校准曲线的线性,回算误差限 2%
say.note: 输出线性、失拟与残差统计

say.text: 比较这两套方法在 2% 边际下是否等效
say.note: 用 TOST 判断等效性,而非 p 值

howto.what_en: It plans analytical method validation under a chosen framework (ICH Q2(R2), USP, ICH M10, CLSI), computes linearity, precision, detection-limit and transfer statistics, and drafts protocols. Scripts report only; none concludes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "method validation", "AMV" etc., or when designing a validation study, evaluating data, transferring a method, or judging whether a procedure is fit for purpose.

say_en.text: Plan an ICH Q2(R2) validation protocol for an HPLC assay
say_en.note: Outputs a protocol skeleton; acceptance criteria stay blank

say_en.text: Check this calibration curve for linearity with a 2% back-calculated error limit
say_en.note: Reports linearity statistics and writes citations to stderr

say_en.text: Compare the two methods against a 2% equivalence margin
say_en.note: Runs TOST and slope comparison, not a plain p-value
